_doc: PVR-INOX merger effective 2023-02-06. Pre-merger, PVR was in Midcap 150 (223). Post-merger, the surviving entity PVRINOX was placed by NSE in Nifty 500 (221) + Smallcap 250 (227) — NOT in Midcap 150. The size threshold criteria put it below Midcap 150 cut. So this override: PVR exits 223 on the merger date; PVRINOX enters 221 + 227 the same day. PVR also exits 221 (it was implicitly there as a Midcap 150 member).
